text: 10 OVERDOSAGE A patient in the clinical expanded access program received an overdose of 2.5 mg/m 2 twice daily for 5 days in the 16 th cycle. The patient presented with gastrointestinal disorders, gingival hemorrhage, alopecia, and Grade 4 thrombocytopenia and neutropenia. When SYNRIBO treatment was temporarily interrupted the gastrointestinal disorders and hemorrhagic syndrome resolved, and neutrophil values returned to within normal range. The alopecia and thrombocytopenia (Grade 1) improved, and SYNRIBO was restarted. No specific antidote for SYNRIBO overdose is known. Management of overdosage should include general supportive measures, including monitoring of hematologic parameters.
